_comment: Hands that touch a repo or the local machine. run-tests is destructive-flagged: it will always ask before firing.

tools.name: Git status
tools.description: Short branch/status for a repo. Cheap way to find out what is actually dirty before touching anything.

repo.description: Absolute path to the git repository.

tools.name: Run the test suite
tools.description: Run a node test file and return its output. Flags as destructive so it never fires without a yes.

file.description: Absolute path to the .test.js file to run.

tools.name: Check the local model
tools.description: Ask the local Ollama which models are installed. Pinned to loopback -- a manifest cannot be pointed at a remote host by a request.
